author: Vitor
aiExplanation: This function finds the **maximum distance** between elements of different colors in an array. If the `colors[0]` and the last element have different values, it immediately returns the **maximum possible distance** (array length minus 1). Otherwise, it loops through each position looking for the first element that differs from `colors[0]`, then calculates the maximum distance from either the beginning or end of that position using `Math.max()`, tracking the greatest distance found in `max`.

author: Vitor
aiExplanation: This function also finds the **maximum distance** between differently-colored elements in an array. If the first and last elements differ, it returns the full array span (`n - 1`). When they match, it stores that matching color as `target` and searches **simultaneously from both ends** toward the middle, checking each pair of positions to find where the color differs from the target. As soon as it finds a mismatch, it returns `n - 1 - i` (the distance to that position from the end); if all elements match the target color, it returns **-1**.
